MIT 3.071 Amorphous Materials, Spring 2025
Instructor: Juejun Hu
This lecture covers characterizing amorphous materials using X-ray diffraction, pair distribution functions, Raman spectroscopy, and DSC. Includes structural, thermal, and glass transition analyses using various analytical methods.
